Q5651.reason: An “as is” clause excludes implied warranties but does not shield the seller from liability for misrepresenting the car’s model year.

Q5672.reason: A self-defense acquittal establishes that the killing was justified, leaving no crime for which the defendant can be held liable.

Q8537.reason: Separating punishment’s concept from its justification keeps its definition descriptive and value-neutral rather than presupposing a moral conclusion.
